title: Puharich jokes on tape about being a double agent for Israel

tellings.quote: um, he he kind of jokingly says, "Oh, I'm an I'm I'm a I'm a double agent

plain: On a tape recording, a doctor and psychic researcher named Andrija Puharich is said to joke that he was a double agent for Israel: "Oh, I'm a double agent." A researcher named Greg Malatzi, who has gone through Puharich's papers and tapes, describes the moment. If there was truth behind the joke, Puharich was serving more than one country's spy services.
